assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
I34.0 corresponds to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered.
The purpose of the monitoring was to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmias and assess for rhythm disturbances contributing to the patient's clinical presentation.
Related symptoms were documented as R00.2 and R42.
There was an absence of precertification at time of service.
This appeal requests reconsideration of the medical necessity determination for this diagnostic procedure.
